title: a browse-only FamilySearch holder is off the fetch list, with the reason kept on the step
line: the Franklin County probate citation's holder is a FamilySearch catalog description (fs_images), browsed film by film by a hand, no search or record page for the browser to save: the step stays on the plan, fetch, with the reason in its rationale, but never reaches tools/fetches.py's list, and a turn does not pause on it; no name with an unfilled <year> or <ark id> placeholder is ever printed

steps.say: Thomas Ahearn's own probate citation is a fetch step at the browse-only FamilySearch catalog holder

expect.why: the step stays planned and fetchable, the reason in its rationale
